title: Exact fixed-scalar restriction to an etale chart
statement: Let X be any scheme, B any commutative ring in the scheme universe, R a commutative ring sheaf on X_proet and phi:constant(B)->R any map. For V in X_et define F_V from R-module sheaves on X_proet to fixed ULift(B)-module sheaves on V.left_proet by restricting scalars along phi, restricting to constant sections, and restricting sections along V.hom. Constant coefficients and module realizations are those of [def-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-quotient-model-data] and [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-module-encoding]. This actual composite is additive and preserves finite limits and finite colimits. If the ringed-slice restriction of M at V is zero, F_V(M) is zero. No isomorphism hypothesis on phi, boundedness, finiteness or nonempty-chart assumption is required.

proof.text: Construct the composite scalar-restriction/constant-scalar-encoding/sectionwise-localization functor. Scalar restriction preserves the underlying additive sheaf; reflecting finite limits and colimits through the faithful exact underlying additive-sheaf functor proves its exactness.

Constant-scalar encoding is an equivalence, so is exact and additive. Sectionwise localization is right adjoint to extension from the slice and left adjoint to direct image; it is additive on sections and hence exact. Compose these properties.

Every chart-site object T gives a morphism from its composite with V.hom to V. Evaluate the zero restricted module at this slice object to see that all section modules of F_V(M) are subsingletons. Thus its identity morphism is zero.
